sources.snippet: What is SmolLM2? SmolLM2 is HuggingFace's open-weights language model. Released in 2024-11, it ships in 3 sizes (135M, 360M, 1.7B) and is licensed Apache 2.0. The most popular use case is small chat and tool use on any hardware. VRAM and hardware The smallest 135M size needs at least CPU VRAM; the largest 1.7B needs around CPU.
